        .IF     PASS
PASS    EQU     1
PASS2   EQU     1
        .ENDIF
;
        DEFMAC  PLAYPIT
;
KEY     =       [#5C08]
        .IF     KEY-"q"
YPOS    =       YPOS-1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"a"
YPOS    =       YPOS+1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"o"
XPOS    =       XPOS-1&31
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"p"
XPOS    =       XPOS+1&31
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     YPOS-#FFFF
YPOS    =       23
        .ENDIF
        .IF     YPOS-24
YPOS    =       0
        .ENDIF
        ORG     32*[LAST+#7001]+[LAST+#7000]+#5800
        DEFB    ATRFREE
HADR    =       32*YPOS+XPOS+#5800
;
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRSN
GAMEOVER        =       1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRFREE-128
RABBIT          =       0
        .ENDIF
;
        ORG     HADR
        DEFB    ATRSN
        ORG     HEAD+#7000
        DEFB    XPOS
        DEFB    YPOS
HEAD    =       HEAD+2&#0FFF
        .IF     FLAG
LAST    =       LAST+2&#0FFF
        .ELSE
FLAG    =       FLAG-1
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     RABBIT
HADR    =       256*[HEAD+LAST]+[HEAD+LAST+1]&#2FF+#5800
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRFREE
        ORG     HADR
        DEFB    ATRFREE+128
RABBIT  =       1
FLAG    =       4
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     PASS2|GAMEOVER
        PLAYPIT
        .ENDIF
        ENDMAC
;
ATRFREE EQU     [#5800]
ATRSN   EQU     ATRFREE&7*8+(ATRFREE/8&7)
;
        ORG     #4000
        DEFS    256,#FF
        DEFS    2048-512,#81
        DEFS    256,#FF
        DEFS    256,#FF
        DEFS    2048-512,#81
        DEFS    256,#FF
        DEFS    256,#FF
        DEFS    2048-512,#81
        DEFS    256,#FF
        ORG     #5800
        DEFS    768,ATRFREE
        ORG     #7000
        DEFS    #1000
HEAD    EQU     4
LAST    EQU     0
XPOS    EQU     0
YPOS    EQU     0
KEY     EQU     "p"
HADR    EQU     0
GAMEOVER        EQU     0
RABBIT  EQU     0
FLAG    EQU     0
;
        ORG     #5C08
        DEFB    "p"
;
        PLAYPIT
;
        .IF     GAMEOVER-1
        DISPLAY GAMEOVER
TOTALSCORE      EQU     HEAD-LAST&#FFF/2
        DISPLAY TOTALSCORE
        .ENDIF
;
PASS2   =       0
